source: HP QuickSpecs c08893141 v16 (Feb 2025): component list, side photos, 315.6 × 224.5 × 16.35 mm. Positions measured from the QuickSpecs side photos (about ±5 mm); verify with a ruler on your unit.

ports.label: HDMI 2.1
ports.info: Connect an external monitor, TV or meeting-room projector.
tips: Press Win + P to choose Duplicate or Extend.

ports.label: USB-A 5Gbps (charging)
ports.info: USB-A port that can charge a phone or other device.

ports.label: Thunderbolt 4 / USB-C
ports.info: Charging, displays, docks and fast data through one cable. Use either USB-C port for the charger.
tips: Plug the HP USB-C charger or a USB-C/Thunderbolt dock in here.

ports.label: Thunderbolt 4 / USB-C
ports.info: Second Thunderbolt 4 port, same features as the first.

ports.label: Power light
ports.info: Power indicator LED next to the USB-C ports (HP QuickSpecs item 5).
tips: Steady usually means on, blinking means asleep, off means off or hibernating. Check the HP user guide for your unit.

ports.label: Smart card reader
ports.info: Insert a smart card (employee ID or security card) to sign in.

ports.label: Headphone/mic jack
ports.info: Headphones, headsets with a microphone, or speakers.

ports.label: USB-A 5Gbps
ports.info: For mice, keyboards, USB drives and other accessories.

ports.label: Security lock slot
ports.info: Attach a cable lock to secure the laptop to a desk.

ports.label: Nano SIM slot
ports.info: For a nano SIM card on models with 4G/5G mobile broadband.
specs: Nano SIM card slot (only on WWAN models)

ports.label: Power button
ports.info: Top-right corner of the keyboard. Press to turn on or sleep. It has a built-in light.
tips: Hold for about 10 seconds to force a shutdown if the laptop freezes.

ports.label: Fingerprint sensor
ports.info: Touch to sign in with Windows Hello. Separate from the power button, below the keyboard.
specs: HP fingerprint sensor (optional, chosen at purchase)

ports.label: Touchpad
ports.info: Multi-touch touchpad. Supports Windows Precision gestures (two-finger scroll, three-finger swipe).

ports.label: 5MP + IR camera, shutter
ports.info: Webcam with an infrared camera for face sign-in, a webcam light, and a sliding privacy shutter.
specs: 5 MP camera (+ IR on some models)
tips: Slide the shutter across to cover the camera.
